label: token right after y, early in the original phase (sparse, depends on prefix)
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.03% of steps). About 90% of its activation mass is in the original phase at t=2-4, and about 72% is on the step right after a y input. It also fires at t=2 after a 1 (e.g. 1 1 e, a 1 e), and in the copy phase at recall_idx=1 for short sequences starting o m / o 1 (top activation: o m 1 <DEL> [o]). It is stronger when the current token is e, c, 3, s or o and the earlier tokens come from {o, m, 1, a}, e.g. o m y y [e] and m 1 y [c]. The highest activations are on prefixes beginning o m, o 1 or m 1. It never fires at t=0-1 or at t>=7, and almost never at recall_idx>=2. Only about 2.5% of tokens that follow y early in the sequence activate it, so the exact trigger depends on the combination of prefix tokens, and none of the predicates tried captured it (best F1 about 0.25).
